root_idea.summary: Burning with fire or intense heat, especially by applying it to the skin.
root_idea.development: The basic action is burning with fire; in the attested verb, this yields the specialized action of cauterizing or branding with fire or a heated implement.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form كَوَى.

senses.definition: To cauterize or brand by burning the skin with fire or a heated implement.
senses.usage_conditions: In the attested Quranic occurrence, the action is expressed of those who are branded or cauterized; the construction may be rendered in English with a passive expression such as “be branded.”

lane_unit_coverage.note: Cauterizing or burning with fire or an iron is represented by the Quranic sense.

cautions: The Mufradat entry also discusses كي and كَيْلَا as particles expressing purpose or prevention; that clause is not securely assignable to the كوي root or to the attested verb form.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: The clause in mufradat:row:1278 concerning كي and كَيْلَا, including the Quranic example كَيْ لا يَكُونَ دُولَةً [الحشر:7], appears to concern the particle كي rather than the verb root كوي and is therefore not assigned to this artifact.
